title: MEMORY WORLD
synopsis: After humanity disappears, a group of imperfect AI robots builds a society inside an abandoned supermarket. As their attempts at independence descend into chaos, they discover an uncomfortable truth: they may still need humans.

audienceReactions.quote: I have watched so many of the context videos is a little ridiculous, but I can say with my 30 plus years in the business this is one of the best videos in the comp. So good. Congrats!
audienceReactions.author: @mentallyhyp2012

audienceReactions.quote: That was incredible this might be the most natural and visually stunning one I've ever watched! Fascinating story as well!
